qe: Jayaprakash Narayan, who led the 1974 'Sampoorna Kranti' movement in Bihar and was jailed during the Emergency, was honoured with the Bharat Ratna in which year?
qh: 1974 में बिहार में 'संपूर्ण क्रांति' आंदोलन का नेतृत्व करने तथा आपातकाल में जेल जाने वाले जयप्रकाश नारायण को किस वर्ष भारत रत्न मिला?
e: Jayaprakash Narayan (JP) ka naam bharat ke svatantrata-sangharsh tatha uske baad ki rajneeti dono me bahut mahatvapurn hai; 1942 ke Bharat Chhodo Andolan me unhone bhag liya tatha jail me unhe kaafi yaatnayein sahi karni padi. 1974 me unhone Bihar se 'Sampoorna Kranti' (Total Revolution) ka aavhan diya, jisme vidyarthi tatha aam janta ne bhrashtachar tatha badhti mehngai ke khilaf bade aandolan kiye; 1975 me jab desh me aapatkal (Emergency) lagaya gaya, tab unhe giraftar kiya gaya. Unhe marnoparat 1999 me Bharat Ratna se sammanit kiya gaya, isliye 1975 ya 2001 sahi nahi hain. JP ne 'Sarvodaya' tatha 'Bhoodan' jaise vicharon ka samarthan kiya tatha kaha jaata hai ki unki prerna se aage chal kar kai rajnitik badlav aaye; unke samman me Patna ke paas Ganga par bana ek bada pul 'Mahatma Gandhi Setu' kehlata hai tatha kai sansthan JP ke naam se juda hai, isliye naam yaad rakhna upyogi hai. Exam point: JP dwara 1974 me Bihar se 'Sampoorna Kranti' aandolan; aapatkal me jail; 1999 me (marnoparat) Bharat Ratna; JP ka naam svatantrata-sangharsh tatha loknayak ke roop me prasiddh.

qe: Swami Sahajanand Saraswati, who founded the Bihar Kisan Sabha, is best known as:
qh: बिहार किसान सभा की स्थापना करने वाले स्वामी सहजानंद सरस्वती मुख्यतः किस रूप में जाने जाते हैं?
oe: A pioneer leader of the peasant movement in Bihar
The first Chief Minister of Bihar
oh: बिहार में किसान आंदोलन के अग्रणी नेता
e: Swami Sahajanand Saraswati Bihar ke sabse bade kisan-neta maane jaate hain; unhone 1929 me 'Bihar Kisan Sabha' ki sthapna ki tatha kisanon ko unke haq ke liye sansthit kiya. Unka janm Ghazipur kshetra me hua tha, lekin unka kaam tatha pehchan Bihar se jud gayi; unhone zamindaron tatha angrej sarkar ke atyachar ke khilaf aandolan chala kar lagan (rent), beth-begari tatha zameen se jude adhikaron ke liye ladai ladi. Woh kisanon ke akhbaar 'Hunkar' tatha 'Kisan Samachar' jaise patron se jude rahe, tatha unhe Sardar Patel tatha anya netaon ke saath sanyukt kisan-sammelanon ka netritva karne ka mauka mila; aage 'All India Kisan Sabha' banne me unka bada yogdan raha. Woh swamiji the, isliye unhe 'Swami' kaha jaata tha tatha 1942 ke Bharat Chhodo Andolan me bhi unhe jail jaana pada. Pehle mukhyamantri Dr. Sri Krishna Singh the tatha Mithila ki chitrakala tatha Nalanda University anya vishay hain, isliye sahi uttar kisan-andolan ka netritva hai. Exam point: Swami Sahajanand Saraswati = Bihar Kisan Sabha (1929) ke sansthapak, kisan-aandolan ke agrani neta, 'Hunkar' akhbaar se jude; All India Kisan Sabha ke gathan me bhi bhag.

qe: Maulana Mazharul Haque, an important freedom fighter from Bihar, is associated with which organisation and institution?
qh: बिहार के महत्वपूर्ण स्वतंत्रता सेनानी मौलाना मज़हरूल हक़ किस संगठन तथा संस्था से जुड़े हैं?
oe: Home Rule League and Sadaqat Ashram, Patna
Indian National Army and Rani Jhansi Regiment
Servants of India Society and Servants of the People Society
Hindustan Socialist Republican Association and Bihar Vidyapeeth
oh: होम रूल लीग तथा सदाकत आश्रम, पटना
इंडियन नेशनल आर्मी तथा रानी झाँसी रेजिमेंट
सर्वेंट्स ऑफ इंडिया सोसाइटी तथा सर्वेंट्स ऑफ द पीपल सोसाइटी
हिंदुस्तान सोशलिस्ट रिपब्लिकन एसोसिएशन तथा बिहार विद्यापीठ
e: Maulana Mazharul Haque Bihar ke aise neta the jinhone svatantrata-sangharsh me hindu-muslim dono samudayon ko saath lakar chalne ka sandesh diya. Woh 'Home Rule League' ke kaam se jude tatha Champaran Satyagraha (1917) me unhone kisanon ke paksh me vaqalat tatha sahayog diya; isi tarah woh Khilafat tatha Asahyog Andolan me bhi sakriya rahe. Unki sabse badi den 'Sadaqat Ashram' (Patna) hai - unhone apni zameen tatha sampatti di kar is ashram ki sthapna me madad ki, jo aage Sadaqat Ashram Press, rashtriya shiksha tatha akhbaar 'The Motherland' jaise kaam ka kendra bana. Baad me Dr. Rajendra Prasad ne bhi isi ashram me samay bitaya tatha azaadi ke baad yah Bihar ke rashtriya jeevan ka mahatvapurn sthal raha. INA Subhas Chandra Bose se judi thi, Servants of India Society Gopal Krishna Gokhale se tatha HSRA Bhagat Singh-Baikuntha Shukla jaisi krantikari sanstha thi; Bihar Vidyapeeth ka nirmaan Bihar ke rashtriya netaon ne kiya, lekin prashn me poochhi gayi jodi 'Home Rule League tatha Sadaqat Ashram' sahi hai. Exam point: Maulana Mazharul Haque = Home Rule League ke neta, Sadaqat Ashram (Patna) ki sthapna me yogdan, Champaran Satyagraha (1917) tatha 'The Motherland' akhbaar se jude.

qe: Pandit Rahul Sankrityayan, called 'Mahapandit', who spent years in Tibet and wrote the history of Central Asia, was born in which present-day district of Bihar?
qh: 'महापंडित' कहे जाने वाले, तिब्बत में वर्षों रहने तथा मध्य एशिया का इतिहास लिखने वाले पंडित राहुल सांकृत्यायन का जन्म बिहार के किस वर्तमान जिले में हुआ था?
e: Rahul Sankrityayan 'Mahapandit' ke naam se jaane jaate hain tatha unhe 'bharat me yatra-sahitya (travelogue) ka janm-data' kaha jaata hai; unhone jeevan bhar yatra ki tatha Tibet, Sri Lanka tatha anya deshon se bahut si durlabh vaidik tatha Baudh granth Bharat laye. Unki prasiddh rachna 'Madhya Asia ka Itihas' hai, jiske liye unhe 1958 me Sahitya Akademi Award mila; unhone 1963 me Padma Bhushan bhi prapt kiya. Bihar se unka gahra rishta tha - unhone Bihar ke Saran kshetra ke kisan-aandolan me bhaag liya, Bihar Kisan Sabha ke kaam me sahayog diya tatha kuch samay Tak 'Bihar Vidyapeeth' tatha national education se jude rahe. Azamgarh (aaj Uttar Pradesh) unka janm-sthal hai, lekin unka jeevan tatha sangharsh Bihar ke Saran kshetra me bahut samay bita tatha unhe Bihar tatha sanyukt kshetra ka hi neta maana jaata hai. Patna, Darbhanga tatha West Champaran me unka janm nahi hua, isliye unka sambandh 'Azamgarh (Saran ptti ka sanyukt kshetra)' se batana sahi hai. Exam point: Rahul Sankrityayan = 'Mahapandit', 'Madhya Asia ka Itihas' par Sahitya Akademi 1958, Padma Bhushan 1963; yatra-sahitya ke janm-data, Saran kshetra ke kisan-aandolan se jude.

qe: Phanishwar Nath 'Renu', whose novel 'Maila Aanchal' began the regional (Aanchalik) novel in Hindi, returned which award in protest against the Emergency?
qh: जिस उपन्यास 'मैला आँचल' से हिन्दी में आंचलिक उपन्यास की परंपरा शुरू हुई, उसके लेखक फणीश्वर नाथ 'रेणु' ने आपातकाल के विरोध में कौन-सा सम्मान लौटा दिया था?
e: Phanishwar Nath 'Renu' ko Hindi ke 'Aanchalik' (regional) upanyas ka janm-data maana jaata hai; unka pehla tatha sabse prasiddh upanyas 'Maila Aanchal' (1954) hai, jisme Purnia tatha Kosi kshetra ke gaon, kisan tatha gaon ke jeevan, garibi, tehraav tatha badlav ka yatharth chitran milta hai. 'Aanchalik' ka arth hai aisi rachna jisme kisi ek kshetra ki bhasha, riti-rivaj tatha mahaul jeevant ho - Renu ki bhasha me Kosi kshetra ki bolchal tatha lok-jeevan ki jhalak isliye milti hai. Unhe 1970 me Padma Shri mila tha, lekin 1977 me unhone Aapatkal (Emergency) ke virodh me yah samman wapas kar diya, isliye yah unke sahasi svabhav ka prateek hai. Isi tarah unhone 'Teisri Kasam' jaisi film ki kahani likhi (Teisri Kasam Raj Kapoor tatha Waheeda Rehman ki film hai) tatha woh 'Rashtriya' tatha anya film-patrakatha se jude rahe. Jnanpith tatha Sahitya Akademi anya samman hain, isliye sahi uttar 'Padma Shri' hai. Exam point: 'Maila Aanchal' ke lekhak = Phanishwar Nath Renu, Aanchalik upanyas ke janm-data; 1970 me Padma Shri tatha 1977 me Aapatkal ke virodh me wapas; Kosi-Purnia kshetra unki rachnaon ka adhar.

qe: Baba Nagarjun, a poet from Bihar known as 'Jan Kavi', received the Sahitya Akademi Award in which language?
qh: 'जन कवि' कहे जाने वाले बिहार के कवि बाबा नागार्जुन को किस भाषा में साहित्य अकादमी पुरस्कार मिला?
e: Baba Nagarjun (asli naam Vaidyanath Mishra, upnaam 'Yatri') ko log 'Jan Kavi' tatha 'Aadhunik Hindi ke Kabir' kaha jaate hain; unki kavitaon me garib, mazdoor tatha shoshit varg ki aawaz sunai deti hai. Unhe 1968 me Sahitya Akademi Award apni Maithili rachna 'Patrahin Nagna Gachh' (pattaa-heen nanga ped) ke liye mila, isliye yah baat mahatvapurn hai ki Sahitya Akademi ne unhe Maithili bhasha me yah samman diya tatha 1994 me unhe Sahitya Akademi ki Fellowship bhi mili. Woh Mithila kshetra ke the (unka janm Taruni, Darbhanga kshetra me hua) tatha unhone Maithili, Hindi tatha Sanskrit - teeno bhashaon me likha; 'Mai, Naye Ilake Mein' jaisi rachnaein unki Hindi kavitaon me aati hain. Woh Bihar tatha Nepal ke seema-kshetra me ghoom-ghoom kar shramik kisanon ke beech rehte the tatha unki kavitaon me yehi anubhav jhalakte hain. Hindi, Bhojpuri tatha Sanskrit me unki rachnaein hain, lekin diya gaya Akademi samman Maithili ke liye tha, isliye sahi uttar 'Maithili' hai. Exam point: Baba Nagarjun ('Jan Kavi') = Maithili rachna 'Patrahin Nagna Gachh' par Sahitya Akademi 1968 tatha 1994 me Sahitya Akademi Fellowship; janm Darbhanga kshetra (Taruni) me; Maithili-Hindi-Sanskrit teeno bhashaon me likha.

qe: Acharya Shivpujan Sahay, known as 'Bhasha ke Jadugar', wrote which first modern rural Hindi novel and received which award in 1960?
qh: 'भाषा के जादूगर' कहे जाने वाले आचार्य शिवपूजन सहाय ने कौन-सा पहला आधुनिक ग्रामीण हिन्दी उपन्यास लिखा तथा 1960 में उन्हें कौन-सा सम्मान मिला?
e: Acharya Shivpujan Sahay ko 'Bhasha ke Jadugar' (bhasha ka jaadugar) kaha jaata hai; unhone 1926 me 'Dehati Duniya' likha, jise Hindi ka pehla aadhunik gramin tatha kshetriya upanyas maana jaata hai, jisme gaon ke jeevan tatha uski samasyayein sachche dhang se dikhai gayi hain. Woh Bihar ke aise lekhak the jinhone Hindi ke patrakarita tatha sampadan ke kshetra me bhi bahut kaam kiya; unhone Premchand jaisi hastiyon ke saath unhone sampadan tatha anuvad ke kshetra me kaam kiya tatha Patna ke saahityik mahol ko nayi disha di. Unhe 1960 me Padma Bhushan se sammanit kiya gaya; unka jeevan Bihar ke saahityik kshetra me samman bhara raha. 'Maila Aanchal' Phanishwar Nath Renu ki hai, 'Kanyadan' Harimohan Jha (Maithili) ki hai tatha 'Chandrakanta' Devaki Nandan Khatri ki - isliye prashn ka sahi jodi 'Dehati Duniya tatha Padma Bhushan' hai. Exam point: Acharya Shivpujan Sahay = 'Bhasha ke Jadugar', pehla aadhunik gramin Hindi upanyas 'Dehati Duniya' (1926), Padma Bhushan 1960; Hindi patrakarita tatha sampadan ke kshetra me mahatvapurn yogdan.

qe: Basawon Singh, an important revolutionary and labour leader of Bihar, was a co-founder of which party?
qh: बिहार के महत्वपूर्ण क्रांतिकारी तथा श्रमिक नेता बासवन सिंह किस पार्टी के सह-संस्थापक थे?
e: Basawon Singh (jinko 'Basawon Sinha' bhi likha jaata hai) Bihar ke krantikari tatha shramik (labour) neta the; woh 1934 me banai gayi 'Congress Socialist Party' (CSP) ke sah-sansthapak sadasya the, jisme Jayaprakash Narayan tatha anya samajvadi neta bhi shaamil the. CSP ka uddeshya yah tha ki svatantrata ke saath-saath garibon tatha mazdooron ke haq ki ladai bhi ladi jaye; isi vichar se aage Bihar me kisan tatha mazdoor aandolanon ko nayi shakti mili. Basawon Singh ne Hazaribagh ki jail todkar nikalne (jail break) ki ghatna me bhaag liya tatha Dalmianagar tatha Jamshedpur jaise audyogik kshetraon me mazdooron ko sangathit kiya; unhone patrakarita tatha aandolan dono se kisanon tatha shramikon ki aawaz uthai. Congress ki sthapna 1885 me hui, CPI ki 1925 me tatha Swaraj Party ki 1923 me - inme Basawon Singh ka koi sansthapak-rishta nahi tha, isliye 'Congress Socialist Party, 1934' sahi uttar hai. Exam point: Basawon Singh = Congress Socialist Party (1934) ke sah-sansthapak, Bihar ke krantikari tatha trade-union neta; woh 1942 ke underground aandolan tatha kisan-mazdoor sangathan se jude rahe; Jayaprakash Narayan bhi CSP se jude the.

qe: Rameshwar Singh Kashyap, who created the iconic radio character 'Loha Singh', is best known as the father of:
qh: 'लोहा सिंह' जैसे लोकप्रिय रेडियो पात्र के स्रष्टा रामेश्वर सिंह काश्यप मुख्यतः किसके जनक कहलाते हैं?
e: Rameshwar Singh Kashyap Bihar ke aise lekhak tatha kalakar the jinhone radio par Bhojpuri natak tatha vyangya (humour) ko lokpriya banaya; unka banaya patra 'Loha Singh' itna prasiddh hua ki log unhe unke natak ke hero ke naam se hi pehchanne lage. Unhe 'Father of Bhojpuri radio drama' kaha jaata hai tatha 1991 me unhe Padma Shri bhi mila; unki rachnaon me gaon ke jeevan, hasti-hasai tatha samajik virodhabhas is tarah aate the ki aam shrota unse jud jaata tha. Radio us samay gaon-gaon tak manoranjan tatha jaankari ka sabse bada madhyam tha, isliye Kashyap ji ke natak Bhojpuri sanskriti ko ek nayi pehchan dene me madadgar saabit hue. Maithili kavita ke kshetra Vidyapati, Nagarjun tatha Suman ji jaise rachnakaron se juda hai, Hindi cinema ek bahut bada audyogik kshetra hai tatha Sanskrit rangmanch kisi vyakti ki 'janak' wali upadhi se nahi jude, isliye sahi uttar 'Bhojpuri radio drama' hai. Exam point: Rameshwar Singh Kashyap = Bhojpuri radio natak ke janak, prasiddh patra 'Loha Singh', Padma Shri 1991; Bhikari Thakur 'Bhojpuri ke Shakespeare' (Bidesiya) ke liye prasiddh.

qe: Dr Ganganath Jha (1871-1941) is best remembered for which pioneering service to Indian scholarship?
qh: डॉ गंगानाथ झा (1871-1941) भारतीय विद्वत्ता को किस अग्रणी सेवा के लिए सबसे अधिक याद किए जाते हैं?
oe: Rendering the abstruse philosophical classics of Sanskrit into simple English
oh: संस्कृत के दुर्बोध दर्शन-ग्रंथों का सरल अंग्रेज़ी में अनुवाद
e: Ganganath Jha Bihar ke mahan vidwan the. Unka sabse bada yogdan yahi tha ki nyaya, mimamsa aur sankhya jaise darshan-shastra ke kathin Sanskrit granthon ko unhone saral angrezi me anuvad kiya, jaise Nyaya-Sutra aur Mimamsa Sutras. Isi karan unki ginti us daur ke sabse bade Sanskrit vidwanon me hoti hai. Unhone Manusmriti ka bhi anuvad kiya aur darshan ki patrika nikali. Exam point: Ganganath Jha (1871-1941) Sanskrit ke darshan-granthon ke saral angrezi anuvad ke liye prasiddh hain.

qe: Ramavatar Sarma (1877-1929) created a new system of philosophy and gave it which name?
qh: रामावतार शर्मा (1877-1929) ने दर्शन की एक नई प्रणाली बनाई और उसे कौन सा नाम दिया?
e: Ramavatar Sarma Mithila ke vidwan the. 1913 me unka Paramartha Darshana prakashit hua, jisme 445 Sanskrit sutra hain, jo chhah adhyayon me bante hain aur har adhyay ke do bhaag hain. Sutra matlab chhota aur saandarbhik vachan. Unka darshan purane vidwanon Gautama aur Kanada ki shaili me likha gaya. Samskritatva unki bhasha-vigyan ka granth tha, darshan-granth nahi. Exam point: Ramavatar Sarma ka naya darshan Paramartha Darshana (1913) ke naam se jana jata hai.

qe: The eight-volume translation of the Manusmriti with the commentary of Medhatithi, regarded as an authority on Hindu law, was prepared by which scholar?
qh: हिंदू विधि का प्रमाणिक ग्रंथ माने जाने वाले, मेधातिथि की टीका सहित मनुस्मृति के आठ खंडों वाले अनुवाद किस विद्वान ने तैयार किया?
e: Manusmriti dharmashastra ka prasiddh granth hai aur Medhatithi uske sabse mashhoor tikakar the. Ganganath Jha ne Medhatithi ki tika ke saath Manusmriti ka aath khandon wala angrezi anuvad kiya, jise Hindu kanoon (jurisprudence) ka pramanik granth maana jata hai. Dharmashastra matlab dharm aur samajik niyamon ka shastra, aur tika matlab commentary. Exam point: Manusmriti ka Medhatithi-tika sahit aath-khandiya anuvad Ganganath Jha ne kiya.

qe: Ramavatar Sarma accepted only two means of knowledge, that is two pramanas. Which two?
qh: रामावतार शर्मा ने ज्ञान के केवल दो साधन यानी दो प्रमाण माने। वे कौन से दो थे?
e: Pramana matlab gyan prapt karne ka sadhan. Sarma ji kehte the ki sirf do pramana sahi hain, pratyaksha (perception, yaani aankh-aadi indriyon se seedha gyan) aur anumana (inference, yaani tark se nishkarsh nikalna). Ve shastra-vachan ko swatantra praman nahi maante the, aur punarjanm (rebirth) tatha sharir-rahit aatma ki manyata ko bhi nahi maante the. Exam point: Sarma ke darshan me pramana sirf do the, pratyaksha aur anumana.

qe: From 1907 to 1918, Dr Ganganath Jha edited which quarterly journal of philosophy?
qh: 1907 से 1918 तक डॉ गंगानाथ झा किस त्रैमासिक दर्शन-पत्रिका का संपादन करते थे?
e: Ganganath Jha sirf anuvadk nahi, sampaadak bhi the. 1907 se 1918 tak unhone Indian Thought naam ki tri-maasik (quarterly) darshan-patrika nikali, jisme bharatiya darshan par lekh chhapate the. Quarterly matlab teen mahine me ek baar aane wali patrika. Isse pata chalta hai ki ve naye vicharon ke prachar ko bhi utna hi mahatva dete the jitna anuvad ko. Exam point: Ganganath Jha ne 1907 se 1918 tak Indian Thought patrika ka sampaadan kiya.

qe: Ramavatar Sarma was the first writer to produce a book on which subject in Hindi?
qh: रामावतार शर्मा हिंदी में किस विषय पर पुस्तक लिखने वाले पहले लेखक थे?
e: Sarma ji angrezi shiksha se jude hone ke bawajood Hindi me likhte the. Ve pehle lekhak the jinhone Hindi me European philosophy, yaani yooropiya darshan, par granth likha, jisse Hindi me darshan ki nayi parampara shuru hui. Unka bada darshan-granth Paramartha Darshana Sanskrit me tha, lekin Hindi me unka yogdan bhi mahatvapurn tha. Unke Paramartha Darshana ko unki mrityu ke baad Darbhanga ke Mithila Research Institute ne bhi chhapwaya. Exam point: Hindi me European darshan par granth likhne wale pehle lekhak Ramavatar Sarma the.
